fact: BCRG Decision N°D/2023/117/GuiM of 3 July 2023 obliged banks to connect to the national digital interoperability platform by 29 June or 29 September 2023, with a penalty of 10 billion GNF a month from 2 October 2023 on banks and e-money institutions not connected.
title: Les banques sous « pression » : Une pénalité de 10 milliards Gnf plane sur certaines institutions financières…
